title: CGIL general strike and student protests clash with police in Bologna
seoTitle: Bologna strike and student protests clash

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against the government budget bill, rising living costs, re-armament, war, and school conditions during a general strike.
tea.want: Withdrawal of the budget bill, increased spending on schools and living costs, and an end to re-armament.
tea.changed: Nov 20: Police in riot gear clashed with activists and carried out charges after protesters tried to breach a security cordon.

summary: During a nationwide general strike called by Italy's largest trade union CGIL and accompanied by student protests, tensions and clashes erupted in Bologna on Friday. Activists carrying smoke bombs and banners attempted to break through a police security cordon near the headquarters of Confindustria Emilia in vicolo Santa Lucia. According to news reports, officers in riot gear pushed back the demonstrators and conducted multiple police charges. Protesters later remained gathered on via Castiglione. The actions formed part of broader demonstrations against the government's budget bill, rising living costs, military re-armament, and educational conditions.
response: According to the sources, officers in riot gear deployed a security cordon and pushed back demonstrators, carrying out several police charges after protesters attempted to breach the line.

updates.text: Clashes and scuffles broke out between police and activists near the Confindustria Emilia headquarters in Bologna during a general strike.
Police officers in riot gear deployed charges and pushed protesters back onto via Castiglione after attempts to breach a security cordon.
